Diff asserted facts against the exchange catalogue

Source: R/catalogue.R
bourse_catalogue_diff.Rd

The grounding oracle. Fetches the exchange's instrument catalogue and checks each asserted fact family against it: are the symbols present, do they carry a price-tick filter, a lot-size filter, a minimum notional, and base/quote currencies? Families that agree are marked grounded in the registry with the date of the check; families that do not are left [unverified].

Usage

bourse_catalogue_diff(
  source = "binance",
  symbols = .BOURSE_CORE_SYMBOLS,
  exchange_info = NULL
)

Arguments

source

The source; currently "binance".

symbols

Symbols to verify. The default is the grounded core universe (BTCUSDT, ETHUSDT, BNBUSDT, SOLUSDT): every requested symbol's filters (tick size, lot size, minimum notional) and currencies must agree with the catalogue for the corresponding family to ground.

exchange_info

Optional recorded catalogue (the parsed symbols list from /exchangeInfo).

Value

A data.frame report: fact_family, status (grounded / mismatch / absent), detail. Invisibly grounds the registry as a side effect.

Details

Pass exchange_info (a recorded /exchangeInfo payload) to run the oracle offline against a recorded-real catalogue; omit it to fetch live (requires the suggested httr2 + jsonlite).

See also

Other grounding: bourse_external_facts(), bourse_fact_status(), combine_grounding(), fact_grounding(), grounding_tokens

Examples

# Offline against a minimal recorded-style catalogue:
info <- list(symbols = list(list(
  symbol = "BTCUSDT", baseAsset = "BTC", quoteAsset = "USDT",
  filters = list(list(filterType = "PRICE_FILTER", tickSize = "0.01"),
                 list(filterType = "LOT_SIZE", stepSize = "0.00001"),
                 list(filterType = "NOTIONAL", minNotional = "5")))))
bourse_catalogue_diff("binance", symbols = "BTCUSDT", exchange_info = info)
#>                  fact_family   status
#> 1            symbol_universe grounded
#> 2                  tick_size grounded
#> 3                   lot_size grounded
#> 4               min_notional grounded
#> 5        quote_base_currency grounded
#> 6     ohlcv_column_semantics grounded
#> 7 orderbook_column_semantics grounded
#> 8    ticker_column_semantics grounded
#> 9               timestamp_tz grounded
#>                                                detail
#> 1 agreed against recorded exchange_info on 2026-10-29
#> 2 agreed against recorded exchange_info on 2026-10-29
#> 3 agreed against recorded exchange_info on 2026-10-29
#> 4 agreed against recorded exchange_info on 2026-10-29
#> 5 agreed against recorded exchange_info on 2026-10-29
#> 6 agreed against recorded exchange_info on 2026-10-29
#> 7 agreed against recorded exchange_info on 2026-10-29
#> 8 agreed against recorded exchange_info on 2026-10-29
#> 9 agreed against recorded exchange_info on 2026-10-29
